# Photo library, 22 October 2026

470 publicly catalogued photographs (47 earlier + 423 added). All new previews were visually reviewed. Full originals were downloaded and SHA-256 checked, and remain in the local atlas-photo-library folder. The public catalogue records photographer, licence, source, original dimensions and original URL. New previews are resized WebP files; originals are unchanged.

Verified source coordinates are retained where available. Otherwise the location is explicitly an approximate named area; a nearby photo does not show the selected habitat cell or its present condition.

Public counts: {"redsea": 63, "gulf": 129, "representative": 3, "eastasia": 275}.
